parameters.name: DtsJobIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the migration or synchronization tasks.
> - Separate multiple task IDs with commas (,).
- Call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to obtain the DTS task IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:

- **false**: No.
- **true**: Yes.
